Kill [[Oberan the Reviled]] outside of [[Sardelac Sanitarium]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = Necromancer
}}

===Objectives===
* Slay [[Oberan the Reviled]].
* Return to [[Kasha Blackblood]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*350 [[Experience]]
* {{skill icon|Parasitic Bond}}
* {{skill icon|Putrid Explosion}}

==Walkthrough==
* Oberan and 4 of [[Oberan's Minion|his minions]] will come from the eastern direction. After killing Oberan you can meet Kasha Blackblood for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Kasha Blackblood
:''"Our plan seems to have worked! My spies inform me that Oberan is headed here even now to seek revenge on the one who slew his minions. Of course, I don't have to tell you that it's in both our best interest for you to '''slay Oberan'''. He comes for you up the road from the east even now. Are you ready to face him?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am more than ready.
| decline = Is there a place to hide?
| ask = '''Oberan''' is almost upon us! Hurry and meet him, he approaches from the east.
}}

===Intermediate Dialogue===
:'''Oberan the Reviled:''' ''"Where is the Grenth-cursed whelp who dared lay a hand upon my servants?"''
:'''Oberan the Reviled:''' ''"Kasha will pay for sending you!"''
:'''Oberan the Reviled:''' ''"Your souls will writhe in agony when I'm finished with you!"''
:'''Oberan the Reviled:''' ''"You will die in excruciating agony!"''

===Reward Dialogue===
;Kasha Blackblood
:''"Oberan's skills must have been slipping. Still you did manage to defeat him, so I suppose you deserve some sort of reward."''
